name: Orders for precious cargo

date.label: The Burning Crusade patch 2.3 continuation; exact in-world date unknown

summary: Garn’s orders reveal valuable cargo and an unnamed wealthy patron.
description: Captain Wymor’s scouts describe red-bandana Defias near the wreck, an odd sight far from their Stormwind trade. On a nearby island, Garn Mathers holds a written order telling him to protect the cargo at any cost and promising a rich reward for success and silence. The note implies a patron with means, but it does not name one. Wymor sends the order to Renn McGill, the salvage diver already searching the shore.
